decisions.quote: The purpose of this study was to provide a close conceptual replication of the first CW-FIT RCT ( Wills et al., 2016 ) by using methods of the original study and following procedures as closely as possible ( Cook, 2014 ;  Coyne et al., 2016 ).
decisions.reason: Both the shipped row and the blind coding classify this study as a replication. Wills et al. (2018) conducted a new multisite randomized controlled trial across 21 elementary schools and 157 classrooms in three states to conceptually replicate the first CW-FIT randomized controlled trial. Prior adjudication/state files do not exist for this key.
